item.title: Democrats Are Winning And Just Made A Game Changing Demand On ICE Reform
item.description: Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries talked to reporters after their strategy meeting on reining in ICE, and they have added a new demand to their list of reforms they require for ICE to be funded.

item.title: Trump Goes Into Hiding As His Approval Rating Crashes
item.description: With his unpopularity growing by the day, Donald Trump is avoiding public events where he could be humiliated.

item.title: ICE Shutdown Likely After Republicans Reject Democratic Demand To Protect Polling Places
item.description: Republicans immediately rejected the Democratic list of demands that included banning ICE from schools, churches, and polling places, which means that an ICE shutdown is likely.

item.title: Trump's Mental Decline Reaches New Stage At National Prayer Breakfast
item.description: Trump's mind apparently can't deliver remarks that are on topic and appropriate for the venue any longer, as Trump ranted and raved conspiracies and forgot names at the National Prayer Breakfast.

item.title: Trump Level Of Core Support Has Cratered To An Astonishing New Low
item.description: Republicans plan to glue themselves to Donald Trump to get through the midterm election, but they need to rethink that idea after a new poll shows Trump's core support falling fast.

item.title: 3 Time Trump Voter Apologizes For Voting For Trump After Racist Obamas Post
item.description: The condemnation has been fast and severe after Trump posted a video depicting the Obamas as apes, but none as striking as the 3 time Trump voter who called into C-SPAN to apologize.

item.title: If Trump Didn't Post The Racist Video, His Decline Is Even Worse Than Imagined
item.description: The White House is claiming that Trump didn't post the racist video attacking the Obamas, but for this to be true, it exposes another lie that Trump is energetic and running his own social media.

item.title: Bill Clinton Blasts James Comer And Refuses To Be Trump's Epstein Cover-Up Prop
item.description: Former President Bill Clinton released a lengthy statement where he slammed House Oversight Committee Chair James Comer, and called out Republicans for playing politics with the Epstein scandal.

item.title: Republicans Are Terrified That Trump Is Handing The Senate To Democrats
item.description: If Trump botches the Texas Senate primary and Ken Paxton becomes the nominee, the GOP is worried that it could cost them the Senate.

item.title: Trump's Inner Circle May Be Compromised As Whistleblower Complaint Rocks White House
item.description: The whistleblower complaint that the administration is hiding involves foreign intelligence talking to a person close to Trump, but Tulsi Gabbard hand delivered the info to the White House.
